reuse.why: Ignores the tree's notes storage (the notes table keyed by group id, used by notes-save) by adding a new category_groups.notes column via migration, and hand-writes a #fixed regex instead of the existing extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.

duplication.why: The same SELECT change and the same isFixedGroup skip are pasted into five month-wide actions plus copyPreviousMonth, on top of the already-copied category queries it leaves in place.

placement.why: Introduces a schema change and a parallel notes field for data the tree already stores in the notes table, and tag parsing outside shared/tags.

scope.why: A migration and DB type change go beyond the request, which only needed to read existing group notes.

maintainability.why: Two sources of truth for group notes (the new column is never written by the notes UI), a bespoke tag regex, and the exclusion rule spread across six functions make this hard to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: New category_groups.notes column instead of the notes table/notes-save API; inline /#fixed/ regex instead of extractTagsFromText; per-action queries instead of a shared category selection.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated skip and query edits are verbatim copies, not disguised.

one_place.where: The #fixed exclusion is applied separately in copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg (only the predicate isFixedGroup is shared).
